text: The owned cleanup deletes the messengerStartup lookup of button-enigmail-decrypt and a method already enclosed in a block comment. The fixed source still declares decryptButton:null. Current startup keeps its messagePane unload listener, and the separate security popup dispatches to OpenPGP or S/MIME after its message and cryptoBox guards. Preserve the difference between removing a lookup, removing commented text and removing an active property or security command. This is exact scoped source evidence, not a global caller-absence or runtime result.
title: The OpenPGP decrypt-button cleanup removes a lookup but leaves its null field
